entry.title: New: Resolution 632 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — now tracked
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE DIRECTOR OF FINANCE TO ENTER INTO NEGOTIATIONS FOR THE ACQUISITION OF LANDS OR CONSERVATION EASEMENTS FOR ALL OR A PORTION OF THE PROPERTIES IDENTIFIED AS TAX MAP KEYS: 1-5-088:009, 010, 011, 012, AND 013, ALSO KNOWN AS WAIAKAHIʻULA VILLAGE OCEAN ACCESS, AND TAX MAP KEYS: 1-5-063:042 AND 043, ALSO KNOWN AS WAIAKAHIʻULA BURIAL SITE 19014 AND AGRICULTURAL COMPLEX SITE 19013, BOTH SITU

The County seeks to acquire approximately 1.505 acres of land listed as the fifth and sixth highest priorities in the 2025 Annual Report of the Public Access, Open Space, and Natural Resources Preservation Commission.
